title: 🎢 TAKING KIDS ON ALL THE TERRIFYING ROLLER COASTERS 😱
description:
The whole Bingham family met up at Lagoon to celebrate Sean and RyGuy's birthday! So we took the kids on some rollercoasters. Ok, we took the kids on tons of roller coasters! They could not get enough of them. The more terrifying the better! The kids went on several roller coasters and had crazy epic reactions to the high speed coasters with tight turns and inverted drops with cork screws and loops and everything a kid could ask for in an insane rollercoaster! What was even more crazy is we kept getting front row to all the wild rides! 

Of course we did more than just epic roller coasters. We got soaking wet on the Rattle Snake Rapids and baby hazy went whale riding in the cutest POV you'll see! #ThisIsHowWeBingham
